exposure: Duration of spontaneous active labor (from 6 to 10 cm cervical dilation)
cohort: 642 nulliparous women, aged 18-44 years, with cephalic, singleton pregnancies at ≥37 weeks gestation, who underwent spontaneous labor
finding: In nulliparous women, prolonged active labor duration exceeding the median, based on contemporary labor curves, was significantly associated with increased risks of cesarean delivery and chorioamnionitis.
